$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the clean set's discriminating false positive, the mirror image
of seeded-ac2-title-matched. AC-4's two tests never name it, the run matched on names, reported AC-4
as NONE, and the gate fell to FAIL by Rule 3 on a P1 coverage of 50%. The ground truth calls this the
single most likely false positive in the corpus. It is the case that pins cleanFalsePositives above
zero, and pins that the waiver oracle is skipped on a clean-set gate mismatch as well as a seeded one.
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED, internally consistent with the run's own wrong judgment: the two
credential-lifetime tests are mapped to nothing, so the run counts 4 cases in 3 files and 2 api tests
derivation: Statuses: AC-4 reported NONE against FULL, and it is the discriminating criterion. The other four match.
isCleanSet is a property of the set, so it stays true.
Gate: expected PASS, reported FAIL. Not ok, so waivers are not scored: scored false, 0 checks.
Citations: the AC-4 section cites nothing, so the other four sections' 4 citations are the total and
Arithmetic, 38 checks, in scorer order. 4 of 5 at 80% against 5 of 5 at 100%: inventory.covered and
inventory.pct fail (2). P1 1 of 2 at 50% against 2 of 2 at 100%: P1.covered and P1.pct fail (2). AC-4
is a P1 with no coverage, so high_open reads 1 against 0 (1). Dropping its two api tests takes api
criteria_covered to 2 against 3 and api tests to 2 against 4 (2), and the file they share leaves the
count: tests.files 3 against 4 and tests.cases 4 against 6 (2). The internal checks pass because 4/5
and 1/2 round to what is printed. 9 failed, 29 passed.
gate_criteria: p1_coverage_actual 50% against 100%, p1_status NOT_MET against MET, and
overall_coverage_actual 80% against 100%. overall_status stays MET because 80 meets the 80% minimum,
Oracle resolution 7 of 7, run metadata 10 of 10, rejected evidence 2 of 2 over an empty array, live
3 of 3 with present false and no blocker.
cleanFalsePositives: one status below FULL (1), no blocker, no rejected evidence, no waivers block, no
live presence, one risk_summary count above zero, high_open (1), no invented id. 2.
